To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the profile of the mobile shopper is that of a young, urban, educated, and high social class individual who uses the Internet as a shopping tool and has a high level of confidence in online purchases.
the M-commerce consumer profile is a young person with a higher social class who is more likely to be a user of other non-store shopping channels, such as online shopping, catalogues, or TV shopping.
M-commerce is still in an early stage in Spain, and the main factors influencing purchase decisions are age, social class, and the behaviour patterns of Internet users as non-store shoppers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of the variables that influence the M-commerce decision.
the study of the impact of Internet shopping behaviour and demographics on consumer mobile buying behaviour.

identifying the profile of M-shoppers and the variables that influence their decision to make purchases through mobile phones, as well as with determining the differences between the profiles of M-shoppers in relation to those who do not make purchases through mobiles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the profile of the Spanish M-shopper can be defined according to the following characteristics: young, male, with high purchasing power, who is a frequent user of the Internet, and who is a regular user of the main non-store shopping channels (catalogues and the Internet).
M-commerce is a new and promising channel for retailers and consumers.
the M-commerce consumer is a young person, belonging to the middle class, and who uses non-store channels to make their purchases, such as the Internet.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the profile of a Spanish M-shopper is a young male with a high level of education and high purchasing power.
, although M-shopping is still in its infancy, its growth is expected in the future.
M-commerce is a new channel that is still in its early days and that its development is closely linked to the development of the Internet.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mobile phone has the potential to change consumer behaviour and that it is necessary to study the impact of the mobile phone in the shopping decision-making process.
mobile phone users who have already made purchases through the Internet, have a high probability to make a purchase through the mobile phone.
the M-commerce consumer is a mature user, a heavy Internet user, a regular user of non-store channels and an occasional user of mobile commerce.
